premises.text: Pre-consumer food waste and rising protein shortage can be addressed by converting food waste into edible-insect protein
premises.evidence_span: if somehow we can convert pre-consumer food waste into protein, we can offer a sustainable solution for both problems

premises.text: A hatchery-to-incubator insect process turns food waste into fertilizer and dried insect protein powder with high efficiency and nutrition
Revenue comes from being paid to take food waste and from selling insect protein powder and fertilizer
premises.evidence_span: Companies pay us to get rid of their food waste

premises.text: First commercial path is pet feed (reptile, fish, bird) grown via influencers and pet-shop partners
premises.evidence_span: We launched our first product in May for reptile, fish and bird

premises.text: Human go-to-market targets athletes, renal and cancer patients, and people allergic to regular meat, enabled by edible-insect legality
premises.evidence_span: We first target three initial customer segments

domains.name: paid waste intake plus product sales

value.text: Healthier, more sustainable protein sourced by upcycling food waste
value.evidence_span: producing much healthier and more sustainable protein sources for humans

causal_links.evidence_span: convert pre-consumer food waste into protein
selling our insect-based protein powder and the fertilizer

notes: Water/land/carbon and protein/mineral comparisons folded into process premise as process+performance package (v1.5.1 §4.1.8). Competitor critiques of plant/artificial/cricket protein treated as framing for process superiority, not separate premises. Grants, accelerators, and customer-count traction excluded.
